test-release-package-dist: pin trace-reader TODOs 269 to 273 (#286)

Case 27 of tools/test-release-package-dist.py now holds the 5 gaps
that TODOs 269 to 273 record for the trace reader, each with a case
that fails without it. The packager and the reader are unchanged.

- fork() = 101 is read as the call, and its child starts in the
  folder of its maker. A child of fork() = 101 or vfork() = 101 keeps
  that folder when its maker enters another by chdir after the call.
- For each of clone, clone3, fork and vfork that strace detached
  during, resumed with the result ?, or ended with the result ?
  alone or with the note <unavailable>, 1 later process with no
  maker is read by its absolute paths, and a second ends the case,
  as does a relative path in that process. After 2 such calls of
  the same name in the same form, and after a fork and a vfork that
  each ended with the result ?, 2 such processes are read and a
  third ends the case.
- An unlink read with its arguments that ends as "= ? <unavailable>"
  counts as a removal. After a chdir that ends that way in a shared
  folder, an absolute path is read and a relative path ends the case
  with the error that names it. That strace writes this form for a
  call whose arguments it read is not verified, and the comment and
  the module docstring say so. The refusal clause in 2 docstrings
  now names the form it covers, a call cut short by <unfinished ...>
  before the ) of its result.
- fchdir into a descriptor with no path, or with a relative path,
  ends the case.
- renameat2 gives both of its paths, each read against its own
  descriptor.
- Each subtest whose trace resumes a call with the result ? says
  "resumed with ?" in its label.

Checks: python3 -I tools/test-release-package-dist.py TraceReaderTests
is expected to give 4 tests, OK, here and 3 tests, OK, on main. Each
of the 18 reader mutants that the pull request description lists is
expected to pass case 27 on main and to fail it here. In a git
checkout with strace, the full run is expected to leave cases 1 to
26 as they are on main.
